== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Massassi Base Sentry]] (Virtual Block 7.1), showing the '''original''' game text. No published image shows this text; the other versions of the card are [[Massassi Base Sentry (Errata)]] (PC-E1); [[Massassi Base Sentry (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2); [[Massassi Base Sentry (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3).

* '''Text source:''' Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet, first printing (official text as of 18 June 2010; not preserved): the re-made sheet's text (copy re-made 28 July 2010, [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]) before the Players Committee news post "Some minor errors and clarifications" of 28 June 2010 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20100714025225/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=244:some-minor-errors-and-clarifications&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]).
* '''Original text:''' “Deploy on Yavin 4 system; it is 'liberated'. At sites related to other 'liberated' systems, may add 2 to power of each Rebel warrior (to a maximum of 4). Once per turn, if you control this system, may retrieve 1 Force when you Force drain at another 'liberated' system.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1007_L5726</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>1_68</code>, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 7 set mark) with the original game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
